cut_size.note: The number of edges of E(G) with one end in A and the other outside; zero for the empty and the full side, invariant under complementing the side, equal to the ordered edge count between A and its complement and to the number of non-monochromatic edges under membership in A.

non_monochromatic_count.note: The number of members of an arbitrary finite family that are not monochromatic under a supplied colour map; no uniformity, nonemptiness or palette premise. Empty and one-element members and constant maps count nothing; a two-colour pair counts once.
